ratings_why.fun: Heat, Scorch and selling knit most cards together, and cash-out against Regrow, heal against stay burnt, and where the Heat goes are real choices every turn.
ratings_why.distinct: Heat that works on any tribe's unit, damage that lasts until the next fight, and Regrow that halves itself play unlike today's tribes, though the +1/+1 verb itself is generic.

verdict_why: The headline Burn to Rise combo doesn't happen as the rules are written, and that is worth one more pass.

points.text: Reforge gives +1 Health along with its 1 Scorch, so Scorch never lowers a unit's current Health. With no 1-Health units, one Ember-Belly Newt can't kill anything, so Burn to Rise needs two of them. Try 2 Scorch per Reforge, or have Ember-Belly deal 2.

Scorch from End of Turn Reforges is gone after the fight, so Spring-Bath Newt only heals Scorch from Reforges earlier that same turn (Coal-Fetcher, Slag Gatherer). That's a nice ordering puzzle; a reminder line on the card would make it visible.
Crested Konrad is the best Johnny card here. A second Heat mover, for example one that swaps two units' Heat while recruiting, would make the pivot a whole-board puzzle rather than one move.
Mother Atra only adds Attack and needs a Regrow board. If her bonus also counted Ember-Belly's self-kills, or gave the regrown unit a Heat back, she would tie into Burn to Rise more tightly.

standouts.why: Moving Heat on a sale makes changing carry a real play, and with Birds it does things the designer barely listed.
Cashing out all Heat is a timing bet against Regrow, the Assessor's thresholds and Nutrisco.
Hurting your own board on purpose feeds the Journeyman, the healers and Regrow at once.

weakest.why: One Reforge when played; it does its one obvious job.
Heat into Attack for everyone is a plain payoff with no decision attached.
Narrow: Attack only, and only on a board already full of Regrow.

flags.note: At Tier 3 it reads the hottest unit's Heat, so 30 Heat means 30 pings (60 golden) at Start of Combat, enough to wipe small boards.
Golden Konrad doubles a sold unit's Heat, and with Birds on Fly South the Heat is copied rather than moved.
Quadratic growth with Two-Tongs and Bellows; the designer already flagged it for the runaway check.
+90/+90 in fight at 30 Heat and 3 empty slots; needs the sim the designer asked for.
